status: Owner-approved trial coefficients; bounded matched-cohort measurement, not complete combat or physical-device acceptance.

protocol.seedSchedule: Existing public randomUint LCG, fixed seed-schedule initial state 0x333224; these are counterfactual initial saved RNG states, not an extra in-game outcome stream.
protocol.actualPipeline: Public scout, finite Mining, physical worker return, real eligible livestock slaughter, Smith/Leatherworker progress, targets, individual assignment, dispatch, and actual public Core AdvanceTicks return.
protocol.timing: Saved workPerUnit=100000 accelerates production; Recon and legacy Pillage durations are one tick for the comparison. No annual boundary, weather or additional source work outcome is crossed. Coefficients and same participant ordering remain real.
protocol.onSiteScope: The on-site columns are analytic evaluations of the shared public equipment risk/offense functions, not a second encounter resolver. Actual reached on-site four-slot/loss/interruption tests run separately.
protocol.samplingLimit: Small matched cohort exposes per-wearer direction and RNG conservation; it cannot certify fine balance or population-wide casualty frequencies.

formulas.legacy: base success + floor(sum of each actual spear bonus / crew count), capped at 10000. A wooden/iron spear gives 1000/1500 additive bps before averaging.
formulas.onSite: floor(base action lethality * (10000 + own spear bonus)/10000). Wooden/iron spear multipliers 1.10/1.15; no legacy victory roll is added.
formulas.protection: Actual shield * body * helmet remaining-risk factors; one product floor. Total reduction <= 60% uses a CEIL minimum remaining risk, preventing rounding-induced immunity at tiny nonzero base chances. Without new armor, original shield floor remains exact.
formulas.customPolicy: An old custom shield above 60% remains exact alone; equipping it together with new armor is explicitly rejected atomically.

cases.contract: No iron worn: original v1 dispatch bytes, shared resolver result and final RNG unchanged.
